messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "measure dose with supplied measuring device"
set: ["measure dose with supplied measuring device", "measure liquid with supplied measuring device", "measure liquid medicine with supplied measuring device", "measure a dose with the supplied measuring device (not a kitchen spoon)", "measure with accurate measuring device not regular household spoon", "measure liquid medicine with the supplied measuring device, not a kitchen spoon", "can measure dose with dose-measuring spoon", "can measure dose with medicine cup", "measure liquid medicine with dosing syringe or medicine dose-measuring device", "always measure your dose with a graduated oral syringe or measuring cup marked in mL", "measure each dose with the oral dosing syringe", "measure dose with dosing syringe provided for oral solution", "use the dropper supplied with the bottle", "ask pharmacist for measuring device if you do not have one", "shake oral suspension before measuring a dose", "never measure your dose with a household teaspoon or tablespoon"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "measure dose with supplied measuring device",
    "measure a dose with the supplied measuring device (not a kitchen spoon)",
    "measure liquid medicine with the supplied measuring device, not a kitchen spoon",
    "measure dose with dosing syringe provided for oral solution",
    "measure each dose with the oral dosing syringe",
    "measure dose with dose-measuring spoon",
    "can measure dose with medicine cup",
    "measure liquid medicine with dosing syringe or medicine dose-measuring device",
    "always measure your dose with a graduated oral syringe or measuring cup marked in mL",
    "use the dropper supplied with the bottle"
  ],
  "alias": "measure dose with supplied measuring device"
}
